title: ASAC Fondo storico, Architettura: national participation and 'agibilita' files of Gran Bretagna with planimetrie / piante (2000, 2002, 2006, 2010, 2018)
contents: Inventory units naming plans of the national pavilions incl. Gran Bretagna: b. 291/3 (Architettura 2000, Paesi con padiglione F-I: schede tecniche, planimetrie); b. 335 and b. 375 (2002: project presentations, catalogue material); b. 423/17 (2006 Agibilita Paesi A-G: dichiarazioni di conformita degli impianti, relazioni tecnico-illustrative, certificazioni e planimetrie); b. 457 (2010 Paesi agibilita G-P: piante, relazioni tecniche); 2018 unit on p. 217 (Gran Bretagna among the national pavilion files). Exhibition-period plans of the pavilion (safety / fit-out).
author: national participants / British Council (not stated)
evidence: inventory PDF fetched by R3 (guard get 200, 13:23:39) -> /home/user/ArchitecturalPlanResearch/plan-research-kit/Projects/Venice Biennale Pavilions/_work/guard/pages/asac.labiennale.org/26049e0f_04-Architettura.pdf; read locally with peek pdf-text, units split on 'Segnatura' and filtered for Gran Bretagna + planimetrie/piante/agibilita (no new request)
notes: New archive-only pointer (R4 L1 covered only the Scatole nere and Lavori e gestione delle sedi inventories). The 2006 and 2010 agibilita plans are the most likely to be measured plans of the whole pavilion incl. basement.

title: Island, British Pavilion: Ground floor plan 1:200 (WA press copy, wider site version)

title: kleihues+kleihues with Heike Hanada, 'this is modern' 2014: Giardini site plan (north-east part) with the British Pavilion drawn in plan
contents: Site plan of the north-east Giardini (rotated, the lagoon wall at right): the existing British Pavilion drawn in plan with its walls (central hall, side rooms, front stair, rear loggia), about 140 px wide; also the French pavilion (top, with exedra), Canada (polygon), Japan, Korea and other pavilions, and the proposed German pavilion (long rectangle). No scale bar.
author: kleihues+kleihues with Heike Hanada
evidence: R101's file (guard get 200 by R101; Downloads/kleihues.com/GPV_Detailbilder_01.jpg, 1100x762, per Downloads/index.csv); viewed in full by R104 (sighting crop R104_crop_r101-0009.jpg): British pavilion plan with internal walls identified by its rear loggia, front stair and six-room layout. No new request.
notes: site plan showing several pavilions; British pavilion drawn in full as existing context of an unbuilt German proposal (de-alt for R1) -> gb (existing state). Others: France, Canada, Japan, Korea, Nordic?, proposed Germany. Orientation only (1100 px).

title: The Garden of Privatised Delights (British Pavilion 2021): exhibition map of the rooms (Kellenberger-White)
contents: Schematic exhibition map of the pavilion's room sequence drawn as white bubbles on black: 'Garden of Delights' (central hall), 'Ministry of Common Land', 'High Street of Exchanges', 'Ministry of Collective Data', 'Publicani', 'Play With(out) Grounds', 'To-I-Let'. Topology of the six galleries and the central hall; not to scale, no walls.
